daemon.intro: Start Doubletake in daemon mode or control a running daemon using doubletake-ctl. The control commands also work with a daemon started outside this GUI.
daemon.warning: Security note: upstream doubletake-ctl accepts a PIN/password as a process argument. It may be briefly visible via ps. The GUI masks the value in its own log but cannot change upstream behavior.
easy.encoder_help: Not sure? Leave Automatic selected. NVIDIA NVENC and Intel/AMD VAAPI need compatible GStreamer encoders.
easy.heading: Share your screen on your TV
easy.intro: Three steps: choose your TV, press Start, then allow screen sharing if KDE asks.
easy.target_help: Do not know the IP address? Leave it blank and Doubletake will discover receivers on your local network.

settings.info_text:
The GUI uses existing Doubletake binaries and never installs or modifies upstream.
Saved paths are NEVER replaced by automatic discovery, even if a file is temporarily missing.
To change a path, use Browse or empty the field and select Auto-detect.
Search locations include /opt/apple/bin, nearby bin folders, ~/.local/bin, PATH and system binaries.
Settings are stored in your user profile. PINs and passwords are not stored.
